title: UAPI stability: GET_STATE omits outbuf_pending for KEY fds
description: crypto2dev_fd_state_info.outbuf_pending is not populated by ioctl_get_state for CRYPTO2DEV_FDTYPE_KEY fds. After CRYPTO2DEV_IOC_KEY_EXPORT_PRIVATE, state->outbuf contains the private key bytes awaiting drain; userspace has no way to observe the pending byte count without attempting a read(). Diagnostically useful for introspection tools and for callers that need to know whether a prior KEY_EXPORT_PRIVATE placed bytes in the buffer. The field exists in the struct but is left zero for KEY fds.
